basic_info.description: Westlake Estate Treasure. First time on market in decades. Endless potential. Original charm intact ready for your dream transformation. Unbeatable location, directly behind Westlake Parkplay structure, tennis, outdoor gym, basketball, baseball, & Doelger Senior Center. Minutes to Lake Merced, Fort Funston dog park, San Francisco Zoo. Commuters dream near 280 Freeway, BART, SamTrans, SF Muni. Featuring 3 bedrooms. 2 baths. Formal living room with fireplace. Kitchen with adjoining dining. Lower-level has bonus space perfect for home office, gym, or hobby room. A rare chance to own in one of Daly City's most sought-after neighborhoods. Bring your vision. Make it your own. Opportunities like this don't last.
